COST-MODEL VALIDATION, phase 1 of 3: TUNING. Reproduces paper v3's tuning protocol (Apr 5 16:15-16:45, time_scale=1.0, ES over (rtt_weight, queue_weight) minimizing p95 TTFT) on the H100:1 AZR fleet instead of L40S:2, so the weights the component analysis is judged against were learned on the same hardware they are evaluated on.

Why this run exists: the first validation deployed the paper's frozen L40S-learned weights (rtt=0.276, queue=0.5) on H100. Any miscalibration found there is confounded between 'the cost model is wrong' and 'these weights were never for this hardware'. Retuning here closes that.

Deviations from specs/c64/tuning/policy_matrix_c64_tuning_p95ttft_2d.json, both deliberate:
  1. fleet_regions are the H100:1 AZR regions (centralus / northeurope / malaysiawest). L40S:2 in ap-seoul-1 / eu-frankfurt-1 / us-ashburn-1 was unschedulable.
  2. Only the gorgo-2d arm. Each policy gets its OWN 3-replica fleet, so the paper's 5-policy matrix would mean 15 H100s. We are validating the cost model, not reproducing the tuning-window baseline comparison.
Everything else -- ES box, initial weights, window/hop, objective -- is the paper's.

Chain this into eval with --eval-spec-path; requires REQUEST_TIMING_LOG=1 and GORGO_COMPLETIONS_VOLUME=GORGO-glm5-completions.
